title: Telegram
description: Telegram bot: notices to the team group and commands from the chat
setup_intro: The bot is not set up yet. Create it with @BotFather, add it to the team group and put this in config.local.php:
setup_help: chat_id is the group id (it starts with -100) and thread_id the topic id. The webhook checks the secret: keep the generated one or use a random one. Then come back here to enable the webhook.
link_intro: Link your Telegram account to reply to notices and use the bot commands as your user.
code_intro: Open the bot and press Start, or send it this code:
code_help: You can also send /vincular {code} to the bot. The code expires in 10 minutes.
commands: Reply to a group notification to write in the issue conversation, or use the buttons (log time, take it, resolve it). Commands: /pissarra, /meves, /noves, /incidencia N, /agafa N, /resol N, /hores N, /nota, /notes, /ajuda.
unlink_confirm: The bot will stop recognising your Telegram account. Continue?

bot.help:
Reply to a notice to write in the issue conversation.
On notifications: buttons to log time, take it or resolve it.
/pissarra [name|totes|sense] · where to start
/meves · my open issues
/noves · open and unassigned
/incidencia N · summary of issue N
/agafa N · assign it to me
/resol N · mark it as resolved
/hores N [time] · log time on issue N (without a time, it asks)
/nota TEXT · save a note (replying to a notification, linked to the issue)
/notes · your pending notes
/desvincular · unlink this account
bot.error: That didn't work. Try again or do it on the web.
bot.link_invalid: This code is not valid or has expired. Create one in Asteroid: Equip → Telegram.
bot.linked: Done! This Telegram account is now {name} in Asteroid.
bot.not_linked: I don't know who you are: link your account in Asteroid (Equip → Telegram).
bot.team_only: The bot is only for the team.
bot.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
bot.hours_ask: How much time are you logging on #{id}? · {title} ({user})
bot.hours_hint: Reply to this message to add a description or change the time (e.g. 1:15).
bot.hours_comment: Description added to the time on #{id}.
bot.note_usage: Write the text of the note: /nota call Webempresa. If you reply to a notification, it is linked to the issue.
bot.note_saved: Note saved. Only you can see it (Equip → Notes).

group_missing: chat_id is missing in the configuration
webhook_failed: Telegram did not accept the webhook (check the log)
secret_missing: 'secret' is missing in the telegram configuration (16 to 256 characters: letters, digits, _ and -)
test_send: Send a test to the group
test_failed: Could not send it (check chat_id, thread_id and that the bot is in the group)
test: Test message: notices will arrive here. ({user})

notify.reply_hint: reply to this message to write in the conversation

never_polled: The cron has not checked Telegram yet
poll_help: The server asks Telegram for new messages every minute (no webhook needed). Cron:
cron_never: The cron has never started (or not with this version)
cron_busy: The cron finds another poll running ({date}): one is stuck

client.help: You will get your website chat messages and our replies to your issues here. To answer, reply to the message (press and hold it and choose “Reply”).
client.linked: Done! From now on you will get the notifications for {client} here, {name}.
client.reply_hint: Reply to this message to answer.

commands_help: Command menu only in the group and the team chats; none for clients.
